numerical_budget.rationale: One tenth of the corresponding pinned PRIMAT regression tolerances, chosen before observing R1-R8.
numerical_budget.relative_difference_definition: abs(x_run-x_R0)/max(abs(x_run),abs(x_R0),1e-300) for final species; trajectory metric uses the per-species trajectory norm defined in OUTPUT_CONTRACT.md.
numerical_budget.trajectory_metric: For each species, normalize pointwise absolute deviations by max(max_T(abs(Y_R0)), max_T(abs(Y_run)), 1e-30); report per-era maximum, temperature location and both absolute and normalized values. Trajectory metric is diagnostic unless separately thresholded in the preregistration.

upstream_reference_tolerances.source: PRIMAT tests/reference_values.py at the pinned commit

trajectory_envelope.applies: every active species, per era; absolute floor does not certify relative accuracy of trace species below it

acceptance.positive: S1 vs matched CONTROL within frozen trajectory envelope and original final-observable budgets
acceptance.negative: cooling_only exceeds the frozen trajectory envelope by at least 100x and exceeds Yp or D/H final numerical budget by at least 100x
acceptance.control: CONTROL matches archived F0 within original budgets and frozen trajectory envelope
acceptance.limits: Conditional common-clock reparametrization only. No physical-clock identification, new microphysics, observational fit or S2 law.

runtime.routing: Whole three-run package >600 s: GitHub Actions; bounded target calibration before admission
